name: Find The Meowls [100]
desc:
Welcome to Find The Meowls! 🐱

Explore the map and discover unique types of meowls! Some are easy to find while others are hidden very well! Can you find them all? 👀

🎮How To Play:
🔎 Explore the map
🏃 Collect meowl coins and purchase boosts
🏆 Find all meowls!

Like and favorite if you have enjoyed the game so far. ❤️

Use code "Meowl" for 50 Meowl Coins! 🪙

More meowls will be added soon! 😼
